race.comment: COOL FIZZ (1) steps up in trip and is backing up 10 days after finishing second at this track. Nice run last time and should prove tough to beat. HIGHLAND FORCE (5) opened this prep a week-and-a-half ago and scored over 808m at this track, getting home by 1.75 lengths. Genuine galloper with two wins from three starts. Capable of playing a big role. CITY OF TEARS (4) has been below her best since resuming and has a lot more to offer third-up over a winning track and trip. Giving another chance. MISS MERCY (8) isn't doing a lot wrong and was a brave winner three back at Tamworth when leading all the way. Worth including. KIRRA'S SISTER (6) has been thereabouts in her two runs back and will only be further improved. Drawn favourably and gets in light again with the 4kg claimer sticking. In the mix.
